This individual will be a trusted advisor to clients, leading complex environmental review and permitting efforts while managing multidisciplinary teams, agency coordination, project delivery, and business development initiatives.

What’s in it for you? Join a collaborative and employee-owned consulting firm where you'll have the opportunity to lead high-profile environmental planning and permitting projects, shape regulatory strategies for critical infrastructure investments, mentor emerging professionals, and contribute to strategic growth across the West Coast. You'll work alongside industry experts while helping clients navigate complex environmental challenges that make a positive impact on communities and natural resources.

Hybrid/Remote/Office Hybrid or Remote (West Coast Preferred)

Location: California or West Coast Region

Travel: 20% travel throughout California and the West Coast region for client meetings, project oversight, agency coordination, business development, and team collaboration.

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by identifying environmental regulatory risks and developing strategic solutions
    • Lead and manage complex CEQA (IS/MND, EIR) and NEPA (EA, EIS) environmental review and permitting projects from initiation through completion

    • Lead proposal development, strategic pursuits, and marketing initiatives

What will you need to succeed?

    • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Biology, Civil Engineering, Hydrology, Forestry, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred)
    • Minimum 15 years of environmental planning and permitting experience supporting infrastructure, water resources, and site development projects
    • Minimum 8 years of project management experience in a consulting environment
    • Extensive knowledge of CEQA, NEPA, the Clean Water Act, and related California and federal environmental regulations
    • Proven experience leading agency coordination, environmental review processes, and permitting efforts

    • Experience developing permitting schedules, cost estimates, and environmental compliance programs
    • Familiarity with environmental inspection and monitoring requirements during construction
    • Strong understanding of infrastructure development and construction practices that minimize environmental impacts
    • Excellent technical writing, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
    • Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management abilities
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Dynamics 365

jobs.title: Product Manager - MSI
jobs.jd_full:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges.

As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.

We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.

Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle.

Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.

About MSI’s Multifamily segment

MSI’s Multifamily business specializes in insurance and risk management solutions tailored to the real estate industry. Our portfolio includes renters insurance, tenant liability, group insurance programs, insurance compliance and verification services, and other innovative products designed to support property managers and residents.

Our partners and customers rely on us for exceptional service, delivered by a dedicated team committed to resolving issues quickly and efficiently. In this role, you will help develop and launch new products, manage state-specific regulatory filings and approvals, and ensure ongoing compliance requirements are met. You will collaborate closely with teams across data and analytics, compliance, distribution, technology, actuarial, and our multifamily partners.

We simplify the insurance experience through a modern technology platform that supports every stage of the policy lifecycle.

The Role
The Product Manager will report to the Renters National Head of Product and support the Product Team by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to develop and launch new insurance products, enhance existing product offerings, and expand into new markets. This role is responsible for analyzing product performance and profitability, reviewing insurance company filings and regulatory requirements, and identifying opportunities to improve growth and financial results.

Job Description

Independently:

• Work closely with the Product Team, internal and external associates, and vendors to support introduction of new products, enhancements to existing products, and/or entry into new markets to reach company profit and growth targets
• Collaborate with business partners including Distribution, Actuarial, Claims, Operations, Technology, Compliance and Data teams on all product related revisions including new company initiatives.
• Conduct competitive, market, and portfolio analyses to identify industry trends, emerging risks, and growth opportunities, and recommend strategic product, pricing, and coverage enhancements to improve profitability and market position.
• Collaborate with Distribution stakeholders to evaluate agency performance, identify growth opportunities, and develop data-driven strategies that improve key business outcomes.
• Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with company strategy, leading cross-functional initiatives and organizational change efforts to drive profitability, market expansion, and long-term business growth.
• Monitor regulatory compliance and collaborate with other areas to ensure all regulatory revisions are implemented in a timely manner.
• Apply mathematical and statistical techniques to analyze profitability and competitive position on a state and program basis, and work with relevant Team Members to make recommendations on what actions can be taken to improve product performance
• Review insurance company filings, in particular rate algorithms, underwriting guidelines, and forms, along with industry and regulatory changes to provide recommendations that will improve product launches, changes, and enhancements.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Deep insurance product expertise and strong commercial acumen
  • Sound judgment and confident, data-informed decision-making
  • Proven ability to apply AI tools and capabilities to improve productivity and business outcomes
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills
  • Working knowledge of insurance product development, pricing, and regulatory filing processes
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, including proficiency in Excel and SQL
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate insights into action
  • Exceptional self-management, prioritization, and ability to manage multiple initiatives

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of relevant experience in insurance product management, product development, or a related field

• Bachelor’s degree required

LOCATION:

• Remote, with optional access to local Baldwin Group offices
• Occasional travel for internal collaboration and external partner meetings

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & PERCENTAGE OF TIME PER PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • The Product Manager will be part of a small companywide team identifying and creating new products with profit and loss accountability for ongoing operations
  • Analyze competitor offerings against MSI’s current offerings and partner and/or market needs to make recommendations on MSI strategic direction and approach
  • Use Project Management techniques to drive implementation of new products and enhancements across all functional areas within the company
  • Provide recommendations to Executives in formulating both product strategy and tactical execution and prioritization

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.jd_full:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world’s most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We’ve raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You’ll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you’ll do

  • Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

  • Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

  • Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

  • Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

  • Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

  • Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

  • Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

  • A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

  • Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager, EBP Operations
jobs.jd_full:
About Empower Community Care

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

Position Summary

Empower is hiring a dedicated, operations-focused Project Manager to drive infrastructure development, planning discipline, and cross-functional coordination across a portfolio of priorities within the EBP (evidence-based practice) division. This role blends classic project management fundamentals — planning, scheduling, risk management, budget and resource tracking, and performance reporting — with hands-on operational work: consolidating fragmented workflows into unified processes, project managing organizational transitions, designing and documenting scalable practices and processes, and project managing the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models.

A key part of this role is partnering directly with leadership, including the C-suite and other executives, to translate strategic priorities into concrete operational plans and to drive those plans through execution. Fluency with automation and AI tools is a foundational requirement for this role, expected to be applied across process design, reporting, and day-to-day operational work.

Success depends on close, ongoing collaboration with all other functional areas — including Clinical, Finance, Technology, HR, and Sales & Marketing — to ensure operational changes are clinically sound, financially sustainable, well-positioned both internally and externally, and competently executed. Beyond these core priorities, this person will also serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Planning & Executive Partnership: Collaborate with organizational leaders to translate strategic priorities into structured, actionable operational plans. Provide regular progress updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to leadership to support decision-making, and help leadership teams think through sequencing and trade-offs as plans evolve.
  • Project Planning & Execution: Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependencies for cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Clinical, Finance, Marketing, and other functional teams to keep plans aligned and moving. Proactively identify risks and roadblocks, build mitigation plans, and keep initiatives moving through to completion. This includes managing organizational transitions such as leadership successions or role realignments, coordinating the handoff of responsibilities and redistribution of work across teams so nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Operational Integration: Lead the consolidation of fragmented workflows — such as contract management, customer billing, deliverable tracking, and internal workforce resource planning — into single, coordinated structures. Convert existing practices into clear, repeatable, documented processes and define clear ownership and scalable operational structure in areas where responsibilities overlap and accountability is unclear.
  • Product & Resource Development (Clinical Models): Project manage the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models — such as new curricula, training materials, or program resources — coordinating across Clinical, Technology, and other stakeholders from concept through launch.
  • Performance Measurement & Reporting: Define success metrics and KPIs for key initiatives, and build and maintain status reports and dashboards that keep stakeholders and leadership aligned on progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Resource & Budget Coordination: Support budget tracking, resource allocation, and vendor or contract coordination across initiatives, partnering with Finance to ensure operational plans remain financially sustainable.
  • Continuous Improvement: Serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation across the division, supporting Empower’s broader move toward integrated, One Empower operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Approximately 3–4 years in a behavioral health / human services operations role, or comparable experience in project or program management, including experience building project plans, tracking budgets, and managing risk.
  • Automation & AI Fluency (Foundational): Working proficiency with automation and AI-enabled tools, and demonstrated ability to apply them to streamline processes, reporting, and daily operational work. This is a foundational requirement of the role, not an optional skill.
  • Skills: Strong organizational, planning, and process-documentation skills; comfort working across ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives; budget and financial-model literacy; clear written and verbal communication with both internal teams and external partners, including experience presenting to senior leadership and executives.
  • Work Style: Able to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple concurrent priorities and shifting between hands-on execution, higher-level process design, and executive-facing strategic planning.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Certifications & Methodology: PMP certification, or equivalent project management training/methodology experience (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
  • Domain Familiarity: Familiarity with evidence-based practice models (e.g., FFT, MST, BSFT) is a plus, but not required.

Additional Requirements

  • Background Check: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices.
  • Confidentiality: This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
  • Work Environment: This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 25% of the time for in-person meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
  • Other Duties: This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: IT Portfolio Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Are you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe?

We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Are you ready to shape the future through technology? Your journey starts here. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

Job Description

Are you ready to discover the role of an IT Portfolio Project Manager in Netcompany?

As an IT Portfolio Project Manager you will:

  • Lead and manage large-scale IT portfolio implementations, ensuring direct alignment with business strategies, drivers, and leadership priorities.
  • Define, implement, and monitor IT governance processes, procedures, standards, and PMO/PPO support frameworks across complex programs.
  • Direct project strategies at the architectural level, evaluating technical deliverables, conducting risk analyses, and driving quality control.
  • Act as the final authority on product priorities, functionality, and business value within agile delivery environments.
  • Coordinate and facilitate architecture boards, agile sprint ceremonies, and cross-functional stakeholder meetings to ensure decision clarity.
  • Coach and mentor project leads and architecture communities, driving portfolio rationalization and IT cost-optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to establish business, technical, solution, and data models reflecting organizational goals.
  • Direct agile project teams, guide business analysts, and facilitate seamless end-to-end product acceptance by business stakeholders.

Qualifications

What would make you a fit for the role:

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent Level 7 EQF / 5+ years of higher education) and at least 8 years of IT experience, with significant portfolio management expertise.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience defining IT governance, setting up PMOs, and customizing PM/program methodologies.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Agile project management and portfolio management tools (MS Project Server, Jira, Confluence, BigPicture).
  • Minimum 3 years of expertise in Enterprise Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, COBIT, Zachman) and modeling tools (ArchiMate, UML, BPMN, ARIS).
  • Hands-on experience supervising business analysts, driving Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), and facilitating live product demonstrations.
  • Mandatory certifications: Dual certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, or PM²) AND Agile Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent).
  • Professional fluency in English (B2 level minimum); French (B2 level) is considered a strong advantage.

Additional Information

Being a part of the Netcompany team, you will be provided with:

  • Opportunity to work in a modern environment
  • Competitive compensation & benefits package
  • Hospitalization plan

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Identity and Access Management
jobs.jd_full:
It’s a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

8am is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for our Identity and Access Management platform. IAM is the foundational infrastructure for every product we build. It’s how our customers sign in, how we keep their data secure, and how we manage what people can see and do across our products. This is a high-leverage role: the decisions you make about authentication, authorization, and identity infrastructure ripple across the entire company and directly affect security, compliance, and the day-to-day experience of every user who touches an 8am product.

You’ll work closely with engineering, security, and platform teams to define what “good” looks like for identity at 8am, and you’ll partner with product teams across the business who depend on IAM to build their own features safely and quickly.

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner in the Czech Republic.

About us:

8am builds software that helps professionals run stronger businesses. Our platform powers payments, client experience, and operational workflows for legal, accounting, and other service-based businesses. U.S. based professionals count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

More than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. rely on our products every day. As we continue to grow, we’re investing in the next generation of our platform and are looking for experienced engineers who want to help shape its future.

What you’ll do:

  • Authentication & SSO: Own the roadmap for login flows, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, session management, and passwordless authentication. Balance security requirements with a frictionless user experience.
  • Authorization & Permissions: Define and evolve our approach to role-based access control and fine-grained entitlements, ensuring permissions models scale cleanly across multiple products and customer segments.
  • Platform & Infrastructure: Drive the strategy for the underlying identity platform (APIs, service-to-service auth, and integrations with internal services and third-party/partner systems) so other product teams can build on a reliable, well-documented identity layer.
  • Translate security, compliance, and business requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and communicate trade-offs to engineering leadership and stakeholders.
  • Partner with engineering and security teams daily to scope, sequence, and ship IAM capabilities, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Act as the internal expert on identity for other product teams, providing guidance on how to safely build features that depend on authentication or authorization.
  • Define success metrics for the IAM platform (e.g., login success rate, MFA adoption, time-to-provision, incident rate) and use data to prioritize investment.
  • Represent the voice of the customer and the needs of internal engineering consumers of the IAM platform in roadmap decisions.

About you:

  • Robust 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning a platform, infrastructure, or security-adjacent product.
  • Direct experience with identity and access management concepts: authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), SSO, MFA, session management, and authorization/RBAC models.
  • Comfort operating in a technically complex domain
  • A track record of shipping platform capabilities that other internal teams build on, not just customer-facing features.
  • Strong prioritization skills and the judgment to balance security/compliance requirements against speed and usability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical identity concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with security and compliance teams (e.g., SOC 2, data privacy requirements) is preferreda plus.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Additional Information

The monthly gross salary range for this position is CZK 1,900,000 to CZK 2,050,000. 8am is committed to fair, objective, and non-discriminatory compensation, and actual pay may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

Why join our new 8am Czech Republic hub?

  • Founding Team Impact: Be a founding engineer of our new Czech Republic R&D hub. After a brief 1-6 month integration with U.S. based teams, you will help form fully autonomous, locally-led squads with clear paths to Staff and leadership roles with the exciting opportunity to collaborate face-to-face with your team in our upcoming Brno office.
  • Drive our “AI-First” Transformation: We are building a secure, massive-scale “Unified AI Platform”. Depending on your squad, you will either help architect this core infrastructure (LLM routing, RAG, agent orchestration) or build directly on top of it.
  • Build the Next Generation of Our Platform: Help shape the systems powering products used by more than 250,000 professionals. You’ll work on complex platform capabilities across payments, workflow automation, and AI-powered features as we expand into new professional service markets.

Benefits and Perks

We offer a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support your life in the Czech Republic while giving you access to global opportunities:

  • Performance bonus opportunities and employee referral rewards
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) and 13 paid public holidays aligned with the Czech calendar
  • Paid sick leave with additional support through the Czech social security system
  • Maternity, paternity, and parental leave in line with Czech regulations, plus additional paid paternity leave from 8am
  • Full statutory benefits, including public health insurance, social security, pension, and work accident coverage

Grow Your Career

  • Access to Coursera (including Gen AI Academy) and ongoing professional development
  • Clear growth paths, regular feedback, and opportunities for advancement

What Makes 8am Different:

  • International company environment with collaboration across Europe and the U.S.
  • Opportunities to travel for company events (including potential U.S. visits)
  • Engaging team culture with local events, outings, and community initiatives
  • Office spaces in Brno and Prague with opportunities to work in-person and enjoy a flexible hybrid setup

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology.  As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices.  We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process.  All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person.  All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.

Applicant Data Privacy Notice:

Your personal data will be collected and retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. jobs.title: Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join Twilio as a Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance — a tech-forward business analyst and program manager within a brand-new function built from the ground up to reshape how Twilio manages, governs, and optimizes its global telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem.

About the job

This isn’t a role that inherits an existing playbook — it’s a role that writes one. Twilio is building a highly visible, cross-functional operations & governance team dedicated to optimizing its telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem. Reporting into leadership that maintains regular cadences with Twilio’s CEO, CFO, CRO, and Audit Committee, you will serve as the primary owner of critical end-to-end improvements spanning multiple areas of the business, and build internal operating models that unlock new levels of operational maturity and rigor.

In this role, you will bring together, understand, and implement the policies, processes, systems, tools, and controls necessary to build a world-class operating environment. You will own the creation and stand-up of the team operating model, cadences, and runbooks while taking direct ownership of the team’s internal Run-the-Business (RTB) engine.

If you thrive in high-visibility environments, love designing systems from first principles, and want to own program execution end-to-end, this opportunity is built for you.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead program execution across four core pillars:

Cross-Functional Governance & Leadership

  • Drive Visible Governance Programs: Serve as the core Program Manager for a highly visible, cross-functional governance initiative spanning multiple areas of the business - including building and operationalizing programs from diagnosis, design, implementation, and change management
  • Maintain Executive Visibility: Package and present operational narratives, risks, and performance metrics to cross-functional leadership, feeding into C-suite and Audit Committee reviews.
  • Implement Core Infrastructure: Lead end-to-end process improvements across carrier operations — understanding, synthesizing, and deploying cohesive policies, workflows, systems/tools, and data-driven controls.

Operating Model, Enablement & Team Infrastructure

  • Build Team Foundations: Design and stand up the new Carrier Operations & Governance operating model, operational cadences, and internal team structures.
  • Author Runbooks & Standards: Author, maintain, and roll out standard operational runbooks, supply policies, and Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for internal stakeholders and carrier partners.
  • Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

Insights & Reporting

  • Business Intelligence: Leverage quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound insights.

  • Data & Reporting Quality: Execute analytical requests from IRSG, Legal, Finance, and GTM stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries. Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines.

  • Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

  • Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.

  • Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

Run-the-Business (RTB) Ownership

  • Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.
  • Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn’t followed a traditional path, don’t let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting or as a Program Manager or Chief of Staff in telecom, RevOps, or strategy and operations.
  • Proven track record leading highly visible, cross-functional programs across business, technical, legal, and financial stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated expertise driving end-to-end process improvements by integrating policies, business processes, IT/systems tools, and operational controls.
  • Direct experience standing up operating models, team cadences, and operational documentation (runbooks, frameworks, ROEs).
  • Proven track record in designing enablement content and driving organizational change.
  • Experience driving Run-the-Business (RTB) cadences, OKR tracking, and operational reporting.
  • Strong capability in process mapping, business case writing, and translating complex operational needs into IT system specs.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive leadership.
  • Strong analytical proficiency using data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Looker) to measure performance and policy compliance.
  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Desired:

  • Background in management consulting, high-growth tech, or global telecom environments.
  • Six Sigma or formal Program / Process Management / Prosci Change Management certification.
  • Operational experience within commercial Deal Desks, supplier QBR management, or revenue assurance.
  • Domain knowledge of A2P SMS, international voice/messaging, carrier billing, or AIT/IRSF fraud frameworks.
  • Familiarity with workflow and dashboarding tools (Airtable, Jira, Confluence) and operational automation (Python, Coefficient, AI tooling).

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • $90,800.00- $113,500.00
  • Target Bonus Percentage 12.5%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 1, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That’s why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you’re ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please consider other open positions.

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24⁄5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We’re deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We’re a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We’re searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca’s rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Our Trading API product team at Alpaca is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive growth across Alpaca’s direct channel — from core Trading API products to Alpaca Connect / Marketplace, our ecosystem for third-party apps and partners. In this role, you will define and ship product initiatives that deepen developer and trader engagement, expand the partner ecosystem, and grow trading volume and revenue, while closely collaborating with engineering, design, data, marketing, partnerships, operations, and other cross-functional teams across Alpaca.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Shape the Alpaca Connect / Marketplace roadmap: self-service partner onboarding and approval, app discovery and distribution, OAuth / consent experiences, and platform utilities that help partners get found, adopted, and scaled
  • Help drive Trading API product strategy by deeply understanding customer and partner needs and behaviors, analyzing ROI, assessing market competition, and evaluating build-vs-buy opportunities
  • Define and own product requirements, partnering with engineering, design, operations, data, partnerships, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products on time
  • Own product metrics by leveraging data analytics to measure success, identify opportunities, and drive continuous improvement
  • Guide go-to-market strategy and execution, partnering with marketing, sales, partnerships, and operations to drive product adoption, activation, retention, and revenue growth
  • Drive Trading API growth— acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization — by deep-diving the user funnel, removing friction, optimizing conversion, and running experiments that move trading volume and revenue
  • Take ownership of ad hoc projects and initiatives as business needs evolve

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, STEM, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, Trading, or building a product of your own
  • Deep passion for trading, markets, and financial products
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL
  • Sharp business acumen, with the ability to balance user experience, stakeholder needs, technical feasibility, and resource constraints
  • Strategic thinker who can zoom in on solving immediate problems while keeping long-term company goals in mind
  • Highly self-driven, with exceptional communication skills to bridge technical and non-technical audiences

Who You Might Be ( Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience building or scaling trading platforms, brokerage products, developer platforms, or integration marketplaces
  • Hands-on experience with algorithmic trading
  • Technical background with experience working with APIs or partner ecosystems
  • Experience owning growth metrics

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
